user_text: 时间怎么能算这么紧的，就是把网络连不上的那些时候去除，然后其余的都应该算上。时间肯定够的。
rule: Per-model actual research interval union minus evidenced network-unavailable intervals; all other actual research process time included. GPT and Seed counted independently.
gpu_scoring_seconds: Preserved as a diagnostic lower bound, not total effective research duration or the user time gate.
historical_resets: Historical actual research duration is not zeroed merely because source/ledger/version was repaired; scientific scores retain their original versions and evidence scope.
inactive_periods: Track intervals require actual run evidence; arbitrary elapsed calendar time is not invented as track execution.
runtime_gate_status: Superseded frozen GPU-only research loop stopped through its own runner; actual Harbor wait130 preserved. No gate hotpatch or fabricated normal exit.
